name: Vince Staples
notes: The lane's most producer-driven catalogue (Clams Casino, No I.D., Kenny Beats, Zack Sekoff) and, in the research's words, "the widest kit vocabulary in this section": ratchet 2&4 clap, half-time trap clap on 3, four-on-the-floor house kicks, and industrial/noise percussion, with "hats frequently replaced by noise bursts". Modelled here as the **straight, house-and-club-facing** population — 100–130 with the clap on 2&4 — with the four-on-the-floor reachable rather than forced: `kick.anchors` are 1 and 3 with `densityPerBar` up to 5 and `offbeat8thShare` 0.35, so a dense seed lands on a house kick and a sparse one does not. ⚠ **The half-time population is deliberately not modelled.** One model holds one backbeat, and authoring `modes` for it would *replace* the genre's mustard/ratchet/smooth moods rather than add to them — so the 110–130 half-time cuts are the lane's own half-time behaviour, not a second mode here. That is a modelling choice and it is named rather than hidden. **Absence is the signature**: `hihat.continuous` is false (noise bursts in place of hats), `percs.lanes` is the industrial set rather than the lane's cowbell/triangle, and `bass808.distortion` is heavy for the "distorted sub or square-wave bass, often detuned". ⛔ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set on the research's own sentence — "his beats favour drones and single-chord beds over progressions ... where chords exist they are 2-bar `i–VII` or a static minor" — and the two families authored are exactly those two. ⚠ **The top line is abrasive by instruction**: "drone-based ... single sustained pitches, filtered noise ... melodic density is minimal and deliberately abrasive", so `densityPerBar` is 1–3, `articulation` is legato, `halfStepDissonance` is 0.20 (the highest here) and `chordToneBias` drops to 0.50. Arrangement follows "short albums and short tracks ... abrupt cold endings, no double choruses": a 2-bar outro, 12-bar verses, and no hook stated twice in a row. ⚠ `confidence` is `medium` on the research's medium-high; **the drum-vocabulary weighting is the inferred parameter** — the research lists four kits and does not say how often each appears. Fill fingerprint band G. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 43 to 42 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 43 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 1. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 919 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary.
